verdict.rationale: Brex has building blocks — travel bookings carry policy metadata (brex-docs-6), receipts auto-match to expenses (brex-docs-7), and AI agents fetch receipts and file expenses automatically (brex-docs-23) — but there is no direct evidence of a unified itinerary-linked report that consolidates bookings, cards, and receipts into a single trip report. Missing for 10: explicit itinerary/trip report object, documentation of automatic consolidation of card charges+receipts+bookings under one trip record, and independent confirmation this works end-to-end.
